title: Computability of the Shannon Capacity of Finite Graphs
exact_target: Can the Shannon capacity of every finite graph be approximated algorithmically to any requested certified accuracy, with no restriction on running time?

sources.citation: Holger Boche and Christian Deppe, Computability of the Zero-Error Capacity of Noisy Channels, arXiv:2010.06873v3 (19 May 2024).
